source: Fugazi leads punk as the most popular artist of the genre and has been paired with some of skateboarding's most iconic skateboarders.
claim: Punk's most-used artist is Fugazi, with 43 uses, ahead of Devo (30) and Joy Division (24).

source: The most used artist from jazz, Tommy Guerrero, is himself a professional skateboarder-turned-musician.
claim: Tommy Guerrero is the most-used jazz/soul artist, with 21 uses, ahead of Curtis Mayfield and Nina Simone (18 each).

source: Sol, the most popular electronic artist ... Baron and Odd Nosdam, the second and third most popular artists of the genre
claim: Sol is the most-used electronic artist, with 35 uses, followed by Odd Nosdam (26) and Baron (20).

source: The most popular classic rock artists during this time were the Beatles and the Rolling Stones.
claim: The two most-used classic rock artists are the Beatles (46 uses) and the Rolling Stones (40), ahead of David Bowie (39).

source: Appropriately, indie music, itself a broad categorization of music, is the most popular genre.
claim: Indie/Alternative is the most-used genre, with 889 uses, ahead of Classic Rock (727) and Hip Hop (666).

source: When it comes to hip hop, skaters favor pre-2000s artists, with the most popular including Gang Starr, Mobb Deep, and Public Enemy.
claim: Hip hop's most-used artist is Gang Starr, with 28 uses, ahead of DJ Krush and Mobb Deep (19 each); Public Enemy has 16.
